headline: Indian markets reopen after Dussehra holiday following Monday's sharp 876-point Sensex crash led by Banking and IT.

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Sensex crashed 876 points on Monday, with Nifty falling below the 22,900 level.
Banking and IT stocks led the losses, while PSU banks managed to buck the trend.
Markets were closed on Tuesday, October 20, in observance of the Dussehra holiday.
Elevated crude oil prices and US tariff uncertainties continue to weigh on investor sentiment.
whatHappening: OYO's parent company is halving its IPO fresh issue size to approximately ₹3,350 crore.
Flipkart reported record-high Daily Active Users during the start of the festive e-commerce season.
Newsprint manufacturers are seeking PM intervention to resolve a critical coal crisis affecting the industry.
US markets rallied on Tuesday, with the Dow Jones soaring 400 points ahead of India's reopening.
summary: Indian markets reopen today after the Dussehra holiday, following a significant 876-point drop in the Sensex on Monday. While the Banking and IT sectors faced heavy selling, PSU banks showed resilience by bucking the downward trend. Investors are now monitoring global cues, including a rally in US markets and rising crude oil prices.
